releaseNotes: Tap a meal card or photo to open its recipe. Meals now has a searchable dinner and lunch library.
Previous weeks are available beside the date and in Meals, including personal recipes saved with those plans.
Settings save automatically and preserve your current week and shopping basket.
Completing your shopping order returns to the meal plan with its delivery reminder.
My Recipes remain viewable and cookable with allergy and equipment reminders. Long methods scroll smoothly.
Shorter onboarding pages have live visual previews and visible controls on small screens.
The first guided step has Back; ingredient gathering stays ticked when you return.
Cleaner shared code and styling, documented module ownership and updated dependencies with a clean security audit.
